Best on a bigger screen

The Icon Maker is a pixel-editing workspace with a full toolbox, so it needs the room a laptop or desktop gives it. Open this page there and you’ll get the full studio.

Windows tablets work too, held in landscape. iPads can't open it, since they only run tools like this from a website.
